rooms.name: Entrance to the Crystal Temple
rooms.desc:
Before you a huge building towers over the horizon. It looks ancient beyond
belief, and the signs of the altar and holy flame above the door and on the
gables show it to be a temple. The entire building is made of some slick black
stone, possibly onyx.

rooms.name: The Secret Room
rooms.desc:
The southern wall of this room is dark onyx which shows up like a dirty stain
against the other three clear crystal walls. The door that was hidden from the
outside is plainly visible on this side, leading south out into the
keeper's lair.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
The dark stone that makes up this room is cold to the touch, and reflects back
no warmth. Your boots tap eerily against the flawless smooth floor.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A cold breeze blows out from under the wall to the north, and a huge door
takes up most the wall to the south. The vaulted ceiling rises high above your
head, and the cold floor completes your crystal encasement.

rooms.name: In the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
The dark stone that makes up this room is cold to the touch, and reflects back
no warmth. Your boots tap eerily against the flawless smooth floor.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door in the southern wall to the east leads out into the bright crystal
hallway, but this room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the
outside of the temple. No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder
what, or who, could live here.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door to the south leads out into the bright crystal hallway, but this
room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the outside of the temple.
No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder what, or who, could
live here.

rooms.name: Inside the Keeper's Lair
rooms.desc:
A huge door in the southern wall to the west leads out into the bright crystal
hallway, but this room is molded of the same dark stone that made up the
outside of the temple. No light reflects off its dark surface, and you wonder
what, or who, could live here.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
A large transluscent door is set into the southern wall here, and the tunnel
leads back east.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
You travel down the hall, one hand out in front of you to make sure you don't
run into a clear wall. The soft glow of your armor is obnoxiously bright in the
reflection of the crystal around you.

rooms.name: A Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
The enormous door in front of you extends far up into the vaulted ceiling of
the temple. There are no visible keyholes, but it swings partly open at your
touch, seeming very light on its hidden hinges. The marble hall branches east
and west, and leads to the exit door to the south.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
You travel down the hall, one hand out in front of you to make sure you don't
run into a clear wall. The soft glow of your armor is obnoxiously bright in
the reflection of the crystal around you.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
A large transluscent door is set into the southern wall here, and the tunnel
leads back west.

rooms.name: A Twisting Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns from the north abruptly back to the east, where you can see
it bend southward again. There's something moving around the corner to the
southeast.

rooms.name: Before the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
A bright light burns beneath the door to the south. The already bright hallway
is bearable to the west.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Doors exit this narrow passage to the north and south. On either side of you
you dark shapes are blurred by the crystal walls. Something or someone is
definitely moving on the other side of the walls to your east and west.

rooms.name: Before the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
A bright light burns beneath the door to the south. The already bright hallway
is bearable to the east.

rooms.name: A Twisting Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage turns from the north abruptly back to the west, where you can see
it bend southward again. There's something moving around the corner to the
southwest.

rooms.name: At the Top of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
A stairway leads down into the depths of the temple here. The crystal steps
look thin but sturdy, and as you test your weight on them, you hear the
curious noise of stone-on-stone coming from below.

rooms.name: On the Dais of the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
Stepping up on the dais you notice the walls, floor and ceiling of this place
not only reflect back the light radiated in the chamber, but give off some
sort of bright light of their own. The hall leads out to the north.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
The passage continues north and south, and on either side of you dark shapes
are blurred by the crystal walls. Something or someone is definitely moving on
the other side of the walls to your east and west.

rooms.name: On the Dais of the Crystal Flame
rooms.desc:
Stepping up on the dais you notice the walls, floor and ceiling of this place
not only reflect back the light radiated in the chamber, but give off some
sort of bright light of their own. The hall leads out to the north.

rooms.name: The Base of a Crystal Stairway
rooms.desc:
Above you rises an exquisite spiral staircase. Sunlight gleams in from the
room above you, glinting of the stairs like fine jewels. At the top of the
stairs you see a small room containing an even smaller door.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You almost walk into the wall before you notice it is there. The hallway bends
north and east here; to the north you see a stairway.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Your boots tap eerily on the clear crystal, and looking down, you notice shapes
moving under the floor... something is alive in the rooms below you. The
passage continues east and west.

rooms.name: Inside the Crystal Temple
rooms.desc:
This grand hallway is a exact reversal of the dismal walls outside. Made of
clear crystal, it's hard to tell where the hall end and walls begin. The
hallway leads in all directions here; passage south is blocked by a gigantic
crystal door leading outside.

rooms.name: A Crystal Passage
rooms.desc:
Your boots tap eerily on the clear crystal. Looking around, you notice shapes
moving above the ceiling - something is alive in the rooms over you. The
passage continues east and west.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Crystal Hallway
rooms.desc:
You almost walk into the wall before you notice it is there. The hallway bends
north and west here; to the north you see a stairway.

rooms.name: The Landing
rooms.desc:
To the east a small door is barely wide enough for you to crawl through. It
looks extremely out of place next to the enormous staircase on which you stand.

rooms.name: A Short Hall
rooms.desc:
This short hall leads east and west and has a door at either end. The door
here is so tiny you would have to crawl through on your hands and knees.

rooms.name: A Short Hall
rooms.desc:
This short hall leads east and west and has a door at either end. The door
here is gigantic, taking up the entire wall.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside. To the west is a door leading back inside the temple.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: The Bell Room
rooms.desc:
In the midst of this room is a gigantic bell so large that you wonder if the
room was built around it. Windows in the walls around you provide a fantastic
view of the countryside.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of the Stairs
rooms.desc:
Crystal steps lead up to the main floor here, and a solid-looking door blocks
your passage south. From behind the door you hear the sound of stone hitting
stone.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply south here, and continues to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply to the west, and you see a door in the north wall to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. A large door
leads north to a crystal stairway, and the passage leads east and west.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel curves here, heading to the south. There's a door to the northwest
that spans the height of the wall. You see flitters of movement reflecting
from the walls all around you.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel twists sharply here, heading east and north. The sound of stone
hitting stone that reverberates throughout the temple is extremely loud here,
obviously caused by the crystal golem's footsteps on the stone floor.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply to the west and to the east.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
Evidently this part of the temple was never finished. The crystal tunnel is
rough-hewn but large enough for grown ogres to walk side-by-side. The tunnel
turns sharply south here, and continues to the west.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc: The tunnel ends at a door to the south, and curves westward just north of here.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
A small door in the southern wall is unlocked and opens at your touch. The
tunnel leads eastward from here.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc: To the west the tunnel ends at a small door, and continues back eastward.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The tunnel seems to end at a small door to the west, and continues its
twisting path to the north.

rooms.name: In the Crystal Tunnels
rooms.desc:
The Tunnel heads of the north from here. In the south wall you see a small
door that seems to be unlocked.

rooms.name: The Slanting Room
rooms.desc:
This room slopes sharply downward to the east. The crystal floor is quite
slick, but not so much that you can't stand and fight with confidence. A small
door is in the north wall here.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall
rooms.desc:
This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here
has a small plaque at its base.

rooms.name: The Grand Hall

has a small plaque at its base.

door is in the north wall here.

This large hall is richly decorated in huge crystal statues. The statue here

rooms.name: The Alcove
rooms.desc:
This small room is no larger than a broom closet. On the wall hangs a long
tapestry.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Flames lick up on both sides of the path. The yawning chasm beneath
your feet promises certain death should you fall.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
and its smoke obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: A lair above the lava
rooms.desc:
The path to the south ends here on a smooth stone pedestal. All around you
fire leaps and crackles fiercely.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
its smoke obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: A narrow path
rooms.desc:
Ahead lies the end of the path. The flame roaring below obscures any sound,
e obscures your sight of what lies before you.

rooms.name: In the endless chasm
rooms.desc:
An endless chasm doesn't really seem plausible.. Perhaps you'll hit
bottom in a few weeks, if you don't starve to death or burn to a crisp
first.
In any case.... You're dead.
